title: poa pratensis var. humilis
intro: Poa pratensis var. humilis, commonly known as dwarf bluegrass, is a low-growing, perennial grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Poa pratensis var. humilis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
